title: Dynamic Coloring and Graph Squares of Regular Graphs
summary: An $r$-dynamic coloring of a graph $G$ is a proper vertex coloring in which every vertex $v$ sees at least $\min\{r,d(v)\}$ distinct colors in its neighborhood. The minimum number of colors in such a coloring is the $r$-dynamic chromatic number $χ_r^d(G)$. We study dynamic colorings of regular graphs. A straighforward observation shows that $χ_r^d(G)=χ(G^2)$, for any $r$-regular graph $G$. We prove that $χ_3^d(G)=χ(G^2)\le6$ for every claw-free cubic graph $G$, and the bound is sharp.
